name: destructo-play
note: A person's first level through the controls, on romdev, GL and WebGPU: the same bits on both; the control never fires (tests/destructo-play.mjs). romdev only: no native game runs.

name: destructo-controls
note: Shoulders and triggers do nothing (and the old build, run with --control and DESTRUCTO_CART_DIR, reacts to them); the d-pad, North and South do act, at a fixed power.

name: destructo-newcomer
note: The human-like newcomer clears levels 1 to 3 with all eight seeds, level 1 within par plus 4 (the full sweep is tests/destructo-human.mjs).
